name: Storey Navigator
description: Walk the building one level at a time with optional ceiling cuts.

catalog.tagline: Walk the building one level at a time
catalog.about: Lists every storey with its elevation and how much sits on it, and isolates one with a click. The camera stays put as you step up and down, which is what makes comparing levels readable, and the ceiling cut drops a section under the level above so you look into the storey instead of at its slab.
catalog.keywords: level floor storey plan section isolate walk elevation
does: Every storey with elevation and element count
Isolate a level without moving the camera
Ceiling cut for a plan style look into the level
Step up and down through the building
